pages.text: Snow fell overnight, turning the yard white. Nobody had stepped on it yet.
"I will make the best footprint path." Gaga stood before the white snow with a foot raised.
Gaga strode across it. Footprints formed two lines side by side.
Mio made a round path beside them. Gaga stepped over Mio's prints.
Gaga covered Duri's and Lala's prints too. "I will step there."
The whole yard was a jumble. Nobody knew whose prints were whose.
Gaga looked for their own path. The two lines were nowhere.
Teacher Bau pointed to a yard corner where untouched white snow remained.
Gaga walked onto the white snow. Footprints appeared one after another in a line.
Gaga walked around in a big circle. A clear footprint path crossed the yard. No other prints overlapped it.
